from pathlib import Path
p=Path(wd)/'programs/task-800b2cab.py'; p.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Fill background-colored cells enclosed by the non-background outline.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != bg or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]; edge=False
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                if y==0 or x==0 or y==h-1 or x==w-1: edge=True
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            if not edge:
                for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=4
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
# construct test; run transform
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'))
g=[[8]*26 for _ in range(9)]
g[2]=[3]*6+[8]*20
g[3]=[3]+[8]*4+[3]*20
